collection.description: A Heathen child asks a grown-up why everyone goes quiet when they walk past the old mud hut.

description_variants.description: An Isolan child asks a grown-up why everyone goes quiet when they walk past the old mud hut.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), a Heathen child, wants to know why the grown-ups go quiet when they walk past the old mud hut. (subject.He/she) asks (friend), who is mending a net and cannot easily get away.

variants.text: (subject), an Isolan child, wants to know why the grown-ups go quiet when they walk past the old mud hut. (subject.He/she) asks (friend), who is mending a net and cannot easily get away.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) puts down the net. "Because some people we loved used to sit there," (friend.he/she) says. "We think of them when we pass." (subject) thinks about this. Then (subject.he/she) asks whether (subject.he/she) can think of them too, even though (subject.he/she) never met them. (friend) says yes, that is exactly how it works.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) takes (subject)'s hand and walks (subject.him/her) to the hut. They sit on the step together without saying anything. After a while (subject) leans against (friend)'s arm. It's enough of an answer for today.
